Info.title: The Venue
Info.subtitle: Marrakech
Info.intro: Stay at the heart of Bailaimos. Find your accommodation and connect with your community between workshops, pool parties and unforgettable nights of dancing.
Info.storyTitle: The festival lives in the hotel
Info.storyBody: Bailaimos takes over Palm Plaza Marrakech, in the Hivernage district. Workshops by day, socials by night, pool and terraces in between. You sleep where you dance, fifteen minutes from Marrakech Menara airport.
Info.stayIntro: Every pass includes 3 nights, Friday to Sunday. Share an apartment with friends, or take a hotel double room closer to the floor.
Info.catTwoBedBody: A living room to gather, two bedrooms, up to four people. A home inside the hotel.
Info.catOneBedBody: A one-bedroom apartment for two. More space than a classic room, quiet between the parties.
Info.catDoubleBody: The hotel double room, for two people. You sleep closest to the dance floors, with Palm Plaza comfort.
Info.ctaBody: Choose the apartment or the double room, then complete your pass.
Info.empty: Practical information will be published soon.

items.a: Bailaimos Festival by El Baile is a bachata festival in Marrakech. Workshops, socials and shows, all at Palm Plaza Marrakech.
The festival runs from 20 to 24 May 2027. Stay packages include 3 nights, Friday to Sunday.
At Palm Plaza Marrakech, in the Hivernage district. You sleep where you dance, about 15 minutes from Marrakech Menara airport.
The festival welcomes several levels. Socials are open to everyone. Check the programme for workshop details.
Yes. Many dancers arrive alone and leave with a community.
Choose your formula on the Passes page, then complete the booking on Go&Dance.
Each pass includes 3 nights at Palm Plaza Marrakech, Friday to Sunday, and access to the festival. Prices are listed on the Passes page.
A two-bedroom apartment for up to four people, a one-bedroom apartment for two, or a hotel double room.
Cancellation and refund terms are those of the ticketing platform.
Workshops, parties and shows from Thursday to Sunday. The calendar is on the Programme page.

items.q: How do I become an ambassador?
items.a: Open the Ambassadors page and send your application. The best promoters receive a pass, a stay at Palm Plaza Marrakech and a commission.
